scope: ten original first-cart branches after explicit master-card and received-instance equipment completion

destination.selection: use the current original task's own raw pair; no random or nearest-point fallback
destination.eligibility: normal movement state0 and original mask1 clear point within current map bounds; reject unknown or unsupported movement states
destination.native_evidence: original RewardMapID/X/Y are client_verified; exact server conversion consumer and original server spawn remain unconfirmed

authorization.npc: current original ActiveNpc map entity and bounded distance; preserve differing BranchNpcID as source only
authorization.packet: original CCommitScenarioQuest with matching current task and actual NPC key
authorization.ticket: explicit completed chapter/card/received-instance objective, active cart, current task revision, role lease, connection generation, source position version and existing bounded NPC deadline
authorization.client_limit: wire does not prove the human read both dialogue lines; no CQuestDialogEnd prerequisite is invented

commit.ordering: validated frozen intent, target reservation, source freeze, target loading receipt, one durable role transaction, source cleanup, exact target connection scene-send barrier
atomic_writes: world durable target and transfer decision
commit.encoding: encode all completion, inventory, current final role attributes and target scene messages before durable commit; publish owner caches and send only after commit
commit.failure_before_commit: task stays active and no rewards; source remains the durable position; resume only using an explicit safe target cancellation, otherwise fence and recover using the durable decision
commit.failure_after_commit: target remains the sole durable position; reconnect from target and existing task receipts without second reward; never roll back to source based on a send timeout
commit.retry: stable server transfer identity derived from the accepted cart ticket; identical retry reads current committed results, conflicting intent rejects; no new completion on a fresh duplicate wire packet
commit.adapter: world and task Modules expose caller-transaction Interfaces; do not copy each other's SQL or perform two independent commits

scene_activation: reuse scene-transition-v1 exact connection send barrier; no invented generic client-ready packet
successor: activate only the original unique next task; subsequent60001 title-effect dialogue requires its actual Jiaxing NPC
implementation_status: see evidence/NEWBIE_CART_TRANSFER_DECISION.md for source integration, deployment and GUI evidence
